reviews.text:
DO NOT USE THIS APP. I’ve been using this app for YEARS since 2020, before I even got married. I tracked everything: my cycle, symptoms, even intimate details. This app had a lot of data on me.

Fast forward to when my husband and I decided to try the rhythm method.
Month 1: fine.
Month 2: fine.
Month 3: fine.
Month 4: fine.

Month 5… I’m late.

Day 1 late okay, maybe stress.
Day 2 late hmm, that’s weird.

So I take a pregnancy test, just for giggles… and it comes back POSITIVE.

The way I stared at that test you would’ve thought I saw a ghost. I cried, panicked, went through all the emotions… but eventually, I came to terms with it.

Out of curiosity, I Googled my estimated due date… and realized something that made my stomach drop. The ovulation window Google gave me was a FULL WEEK different from what this app predicted.

I started crying all over again. I felt completely misled. I know myself and I know I would have made different choices if the timing of this app had been accurate. I understand a couple days but a WHOLE WEEK?

So please, if you’re relying on an app like this alone… be careful. Do your research, use multiple methods, and don’t put full trust in just one source when it comes to something this important.

Know & record. As a user of this app for 5 years now, I appreciate its ability to anticipate the start of my next cycle, record previous ones, allow for notes, ease of locating previous stats and the security option, if inclined to use. 

I began using this app a year after my daughter was born. I found myself being asked about the date of my last period more often than usual. I downloaded the app to have assistance with record keeping this information. 

I found the app more useful than expected, alerting me a few days before my cycle is to begin. It’s easier to “prepare” when an alert reminds you - at least for me. I have recommended this app to many others, it is reliable, easy to transfer between new phones and useful for so many reasons.
